description: extensions/identity.md, anchor lists (0.14): codes are TOG codes; a PG- line is not a code and fails the whole list, like any entry that is not a person code; another registry's code is dropped. Each case is one pg.anchors.v1 list from registry TEST, signed at test time with the registry key of answers.json (sha256 of 'pregen-answer-vector-registry'), checked against its directory at its `now`. Each code becomes an entry {anchor, code, level: 'verified', proof_url: '', status: 'active'}, with anchor 'wikidata:Q11571' unless the case gives `anchor`. `keep` lists the codes a client keeps; `error` is a substring of the refusal. (0.13.1 refused any TOG line; that rule ended with 0.14.)

cases.name: a PG line is not a code: the list fails
a PG line of another registry fails the list too
a TOG line of this registry is kept
a new TOG person of this registry is kept
a TOG person of another registry is dropped, not the list
one code listed twice: the list is refused
a false claim drops the line under its anchor
a TOG event code fails the list
an old PG licence id fails the list
a mistyped check fails the list
a PG person string fails the list
a code with a space fails the list
an empty code fails the list
